Latin word

exprimō

exprimō, exprimere, expressī, expressum

verb, third conjugation, transitive

press out, squeeze out (juice, oil); represent, portray, model (in a statue or a picture); squeeze liquid out; also wring out the object containing it

In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 20.3: sūcum expressō sēminī (Lewis & Short)

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. AP 32–33; Plin. NH 34.66 (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. represent: imāginem exprimere; Traupman 29; Traupman 312

  • squeeze out

    the recommended word · classical

    the humblest bronze-smith by the Aemilian school will render the nails and copy soft hair in bronzeHor. AP 32–33
